promptsByLanguage.description: Prompt templates grouped by base language. The owning VoiceInterfaceDocument defines the authoritative supportedLanguages and defaultLanguage; exact cross-language prompt coverage is enforced there when strictLocalization is true.

Id.description: Identifier: starts with letter/underscore, followed by alphanumerics, dots, dashes, or underscores.

PromptTemplateMap.description: Prompt-id to template map for one language. Full cross-language prompt-id coverage is enforced by referencing voice-interface preflight when strictLocalization is true.
